Unverified Leads

Account Executive roles found on job aggregators (Wellfound, HiringCafe) that have not been confirmed against the company's own ATS board API. Everything here clears the same ICP screen as the main list.

Unverified does not mean fake. Some companies post to an aggregator and never publish the role on their own careers page or ATS feed (ContextQA is one). Others are stale listings the company forgot to take down. Sort by Posted to judge - a role posted this month is a very different bet from one posted last year.
